common.reasonHint: Kept in the history with the change.

bulk.skipped_one: {count} selected row is left out: this does not apply to it.
bulk.skipped_other: {count} selected rows are left out: this does not apply to them.

problem.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to go on.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this here. Ask an administrator for the right.
problem.stepUp: This change needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
problem.notFound: This does not exist, or it is not yours to see.
problem.conflict: Someone else changed this meanwhile. It was read again: check it and try once more.
problem.inUse: Still in use: archive or move what uses it first.
problem.invalid: Something in it is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.contract: The server answered in a way this page does not know. Reload the page.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; if it happens again, tell the administrator.

sentence.default: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to make this change.
sentence.invite: Inviting people (and giving them roles) needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.workerRoles: Giving a floor worker floor roles needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.giveRole: Giving a role needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.endRole: Ending a role needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.suspend: Suspending a person needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.reactivate: Reactivating a person needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.deactivate: Deactivating a person needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.password: Forcing a new password needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.badge: A worker's badge needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.pin: Resetting a worker's PIN needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.twoFactorAsk: Asking two-factor of a role needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
sentence.twoFactorStop: No longer asking two-factor of a role needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

problem.wrong: That code is wrong or was already used. Type the next one.
problem.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
problem.noAuthenticator: Set up your authenticator app in My profile first.
problem.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
problem.failed: The code could not be checked. Try again.

record.dockHint: Show the thread beside this tab (wide screens); narrower, it opens Activity.
record.dockLabel: Thread and history of this record
record.readOnly: Read-only: you can see this, not change it.

form.code: Use 1 to 20 capital letters, digits or hyphens.
form.codeTaken: This code is already used. Pick another.
form.vat: Expected a VAT number with its country, such as IT12345678901.
form.country: Expected a 2-letter country code, such as IT.
form.sdi: An SDI code has 7 letters or digits.

without.price: Without prices: selling and purchase prices, totals and invoices show as hidden.
without.cost: Without costs: material and labour costs and cost sheets show as hidden.
without.margin: Without margins: margins and "under the floor" warnings show as hidden.
without.wages: Without wages: labour rates and pay figures show as hidden.

scope.label: Where it applies
scope.allHint: Every company of the group, also ones added later.
scope.someHint: Only the companies (and sites) ticked below.
scope.sitesHint: None ticked: every site of this company.

reveal.closeHeld: Tick the box first: this is shown only once.
reveal.repeat: This was already shown once and is not kept. Ask for a new one.
reveal.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.
reveal.tooLong: This is too long for a QR code.

badge.title: New badge for {name}
badge.body: Print it now (a card printer or plain paper). It replaces the old badge, which stops working at once. It is shown only this once.
badge.printHint: Print uses the browser; the badge prints the QR code and the grouped code, never the PIN.

pin.title: Temporary PIN for {name}
pin.body: Give it to the worker in person. At the next sign-in they choose their own PIN; this one stops working then. It is shown only this once.
pin.label: Temporary PIN
pin.stored: I gave the PIN to the worker

enrolment.title: Enrolment code for {name}
enrolment.body: Scan it on the tablet within 15 minutes.

overview.title: Get the factory ready
overview.intro: Set-up: {done} of {total} steps done. Each state is read from the system, not ticked by hand.
overview.later: Search across every setting, feature switches and the history of settings come later (W3).

step.legal: Company legal data (VAT, tax regime, PEC or SDI code)

detail.noRight: Not checked: you need the right "{need}".

legal.done_one: The active company can issue invoices.
legal.done_other: All {count} active companies can issue invoices.
legal.needs_one: {name} cannot issue invoices yet: 1 thing missing.
legal.needs_other: {name} cannot issue invoices yet: {count} things missing.
legal.needsMore_one: {name} cannot issue invoices yet: 1 thing missing (and {others} more companies).
legal.needsMore_other: {name} cannot issue invoices yet: {count} things missing (and {others} more companies).
legal.none: No company yet: add the first one (legal name and VAT number are enough to start).

sites.done_one: Every company has a site; the plant has stations.
sites.done_other: Every company has a site; all {count} plants have stations.
sites.blocked: Blocked by: company legal data (add a company first).
sites.noStation: {name} has no stations: tablets cannot be enrolled there.

mail.waiting: Waiting for your IT: the DNS records of {domain} are not found yet.
mail.noneLater: No sending domain yet. Its page comes with Connections (the next step).

numbering.needs: {name} has no invoice number series yet.
numbering.needsLater: {name} has no invoice number series yet. Its page comes with Documents & numbering (the next step).

people.done_one: 1 person besides you can sign in.
people.done_other: {count} people besides you can sign in.
people.waiting_one: Waiting for 1 invited person to join.
people.waiting_other: Waiting for {count} invited people to join.
people.none: Only you so far: invite the people who work in the office.

roles.needs_one: 1 role differs from its ready-made template: check it.
roles.needs_other: {count} roles differ from their ready-made template: check them.

tablets.waiting_one: Waiting for 1 tablet to scan its code.
tablets.waiting_other: Waiting for {count} tablets to scan their code.
tablets.none: No tablet enrolled yet: it takes a minute with the QR code.

printers.none: No printer yet: labels print from the browser as PDF until one is added.

sdi.blocked: Blocked by: company legal data (add a company first).
sdi.none: {name} has no SDI connection yet: its invoices cannot reach the tax system.
sdi.paused: The SDI connection of {name} is paused: invoices wait until it is resumed.
sdi.test: SDI is connected in test mode for {name}: invoices do not reach the tax system yet.
sdi.done_one: The active company sends its invoices to SDI for real.
sdi.done_other: All {count} active companies send their invoices to SDI for real.

privacy.needsLater_one: 1 privacy duty is still open. Its page comes with Privacy & notices.
privacy.needsLater_other: {count} privacy duties are still open. Their page comes with Privacy & notices.

stock.none: No opening stock loaded yet: import it from a sheet.
stock.waiting_one: 1 opening-stock import waits to be checked or applied.
stock.waiting_other: {count} opening-stock imports wait to be checked or applied.

org.intro: The legal companies of the group with their tax and e-invoicing data, and their plants, warehouses and offices. Open a site to build its lines and stations.
org.newCompanyHint: Legal name and VAT number are enough to start; the rest is on Legal & tax.
org.newSiteHint: A plant, a warehouse or an office of a company.

gap.noStation: {name} has no stations: tablets can't be enrolled there

empty.title: Add your first company
empty.body: Legal name and VAT number are enough to start.

org.viesLater: The VAT check with VIES for a company comes with Connections; for customers and suppliers it is on their record.

issue.pec: PEC or SDI code to receive e-invoices

field.vatHint: With the country prefix: IT and 11 digits.
field.codeHint: Short; used in the Office address and in document numbers. It cannot change later.
field.siteCodeHint: Short; used in numbers and on labels. It cannot change later.

keys.fold: Fold or unfold the sites of the company on the row

company.archivedBanner: Archived: this company is kept for its history; nothing new can be made for it.

legal.identityHint: What every document and invoice prints (c.c. art. 2250).
legal.invoicingHint: What SDI needs to deliver and receive invoices.
legal.lookHint: Printed at the foot of quotes, orders, DDTs and invoices.
legal.logoLater: The logo upload and the document preview come with Documents & numbering.

field.sdiHint: 7 letters or digits, as your intermediary gave it.
field.currencyHint: Euro for every company in W0.
field.localeHint: The language new documents start in.
field.timezoneHint: New sites start in this time zone.

regime.RF05: RF05 · Sale of salts and tobacco

company.notReady_one: Can't issue invoices yet: 1 thing missing
company.notReady_other: Can't issue invoices yet: {count} things missing

archive.title: Archive this company
archive.body: Only when none of its sites is active. Its documents and history stay.
archive.confirmBody: Nothing new can be made for it; its documents, numbers and history stay. Archived master data is kept, never deleted.
archive.held_one: 1 site is still active: archive or move it first.
archive.held_other: {count} sites are still active: archive them first.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.hint: Values new records of this company start with.
defaults.later: The default e-mail identity comes with Connections; the number series of this company with Documents & numbering.

held.noCentre: Add a work centre first: every station belongs to one.
held.stationDevices_one: Held: 1 device is enrolled at it.
held.stationDevices_other: Held: {count} devices are enrolled at it.

site.archivedBanner: Archived: this site is kept for its history; nothing new can be made on it.

structure.empty: Add your first line, then its stations
structure.emptyCentres: Each station belongs to a work centre: add the work centres too (Cutting, Sewing, Inspection…).
structure.hint: Tablets, people and alerts are bound to these stations.
structure.label: Lines and stations of {name}

site.aloneHint: Stations on no line: a cutting table, an inspection bench.

centres.hint: Groups of stations that do one kind of work.
centres.capacityLater: Capacity per work centre is set in Planning (W1).

floor.title: Shifts and floor sign-out
floor.hint: When shifts end and how long a tablet waits before signing a worker out. Times are in {zone}.
floor.idle: Sign out after no use for
floor.shiftEndsHint: A floor session ends at the first shift end at least 30 minutes after sign-in (at most 12 hours).
floor.noShifts: No shift end: a session ends after 12 hours.
floor.timeFormat: Expected a time of day, HH:MM.
floor.zoneHint: The site's own time zone (set on the site).
floor.holidaysLater: Working days and holidays (Italian holidays, the August shutdown) come in W2a.

badge.title: Starting work on a tablet
badge.hint: The Owner's choice (F1) for every tablet of this site.
badge.switch: Badge alone starts work — the PIN is asked only to sign, to open My day, or for name sign-in
badge.on: On: a scanned badge starts work at once; signing, My day and a sign-in by name still ask for the PIN.
badge.off: Off: every sign-in on a tablet asks for the badge and the PIN.

line.title: Add a line
line.hint: A sewing line, a cutting room, a finishing cell of {site}.

station.title: Add a station
station.hint: One place where work is done and scanned at {site}; a tablet is enrolled to a station.

centre.title: Add a work centre
centre.hint: A kind of work at {site} with its own capacity.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.body: It is kept for its history and never deleted; nothing new can use it.
archive.held: Held: archive or move what still uses it first.

field.codeHint: Short, unique on this site; printed on labels.
field.centreHint: The kind of work done here.

users.intro: Everyone who signs in: office people (invited by e-mail, two-factor) and floor workers (a badge and a PIN, no e-mail).

invite.title: Invite people
invite.hint: Who they are, what they do and where. The invite comes by e-mail.
invite.name: Name
invite.paste: Or paste a list of addresses
invite.pasteHint: Separated by commas, spaces or new lines; names come from the addresses and can be changed.
invite.language: Language of the invite and the Office
invite.noAssign: You may invite but not give roles: they will sign in and see nothing until an administrator gives them one.
invite.noRoles: The roles could not be read.
invite.stepUp: Inviting asks for a fresh code from your authenticator app.
invite.exists: This address already has an account.
invite.scopeNeeded: Pick the companies, or All companies.

held.noSite: Add a site first: a floor worker belongs to one.

tileHint.noTwoFactor: Active office people without an authenticator
tileHint.locked: Too many wrong PINs, for a few minutes
tileHint.noBadge: They sign in by name and PIN
tileHint.inactive: Cannot sign in on a tablet

pin.mustChange: Chooses a new one at sign-in

empty.office: Invite the people who work in the office
empty.officeBody: Each gets an e-mail with a link that works for 7 days.
empty.floorBody: No e-mail needed: a name, a site, a badge and a PIN.

users.later: Partner users come in W2b; AI agents in W3. Giving a role to many people, printing badges and resending invites in one go come later.

worker.hint: A floor worker signs in on a tablet with a badge and a PIN; no e-mail.
worker.minimal: Only what the work needs (GDPR art. 5(1)(c)): no photo, birth date or national id.
worker.name: Name
worker.noRolesRight: You may add workers, not give floor roles: an administrator gives them later.
worker.rolesStepUp: Giving floor roles asks for a fresh code.
worker.madeBody: Two things before the first sign-in on a tablet:
worker.badgeHow: Badge & PIN › Issue badge (shown once, printed at once).
worker.pinHow: Badge & PIN › Reset PIN: a temporary PIN; the worker chooses their own at the first sign-in.

held.suspend: None of the selected can be suspended: only active people, never yourself or the last administrator.
held.reactivate: None of the selected is suspended.
held.deactivate: None of the selected can be deactivated: never yourself, the last administrator or someone deactivated already.
held.workerDeactivate: None of the selected workers is active.
held.workerReactivate: None of the selected workers is inactive.

user.editLater: A person changes their own name and language in My profile.
user.lastAdmin: The last administrator: the group always keeps one person who gives roles over every company.

password.title: Force a new password
password.body: At the next sign-in they choose a new password.
password.consequence: At the next sign-in they must choose a new password; their sessions go on until then.

done.password: A new password will be asked at the next sign-in.

suspend.title: Suspend
suspend.body: Ends every session at once; reactivate to give access back.
suspend.consequence: Every session ends now and sign-in is blocked until someone reactivates them. Roles and history stay.

reactivate.title: Reactivate
reactivate.body: Gives a suspended person their access back.
reactivate.consequence: They can sign in again with their roles as they were.

deactivate.title: Deactivate
deactivate.body: For someone who left: ends access for good, keeps their name on history.
deactivate.consequence: Ends every session now, blocks sign-in and clears their credentials; their name stays on history.
deactivate.handover: Their open work (tasks, approvals, records they own) is handed over in a later step; check it first.

held.lastAdmin: Held: the last administrator. Give another person the administrator role first.

user.noRole: No role: this person can sign in but sees nothing.
user.sessionsLater: Sessions and sign-in history come in W2b.

give.title: Give {name} a role
give.endAfterStart: The end must come after the start.
give.raises: This gives them more than they have now: a fresh code is asked.
give.noRaise: Nothing new beyond what they already hold.

held.end: None of the selected roles is live.

bulk.endBody_one: The role stops giving access now. It stays listed as ended (never deleted).
bulk.endBody_other: These roles stop giving access now. Each stays listed as ended (never deleted).

held.own: Nobody manages their own badge, PIN or roles.

worker.ownBanner: This worker is linked to your own account: someone else manages their badge, PIN and roles.
worker.siteHint: Moving to another site means a new worker there.

badge.title: Badge
badge.hint: Scanned on the tablet to start work; only its last 4 characters are kept here.
badge.none: No badge — the worker picks their name and types the PIN.

pin.title: PIN
pin.hint: Never shown: only whether it is set. 5 wrong PINs lock the worker for a few minutes.
pin.mustChange: A temporary PIN: they choose their own at the next sign-in
pin.unlockHint: The lock ends by itself after a few minutes; a PIN reset also lets them in at once.

roles.title: Floor roles
roles.hint: What they do on a tablet; at most wages of money.
roles.stepUp: Changing floor roles asks for a fresh code.

deactivate.title: Deactivate
deactivate.body: Ends their floor sessions and blocks sign-in; their name stays on history.

reactivate.title: Reactivate
reactivate.body: They can sign in on a tablet again.

badge.title: Issue a badge for {name}?
badge.body: A new badge replaces the old one, which stops working at once. Its code is shown once: print it right away.

pin.title: Reset {name}'s PIN?
pin.body: Their sessions end; a temporary PIN is shown once and they choose their own at the next sign-in.

lost.title: Mark {name}'s badge lost?
lost.body: The badge stops working at once; issue a new one when they need it.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.body: Ends their floor sessions now and blocks sign-in on every tablet. Their name stays on history.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.body: They can sign in on a tablet again with their badge and PIN.

confirm.stepUp: This asks for a fresh code from your authenticator app.

done.revealed: Done. The code is no longer shown anywhere.

roles.intro: What each role can do, in plain words first: the money it sees (price · cost · margin · wages) and whether it asks for two-factor. Ready-made roles stay equal to their templates; a custom copy says what its template gained. Tick two or three roles to compare them.

gap.outdated: Out of date: the daily sync brings it up to its template

empty.title: No roles yet
empty.body: The ready-made roles appear after the first sync.

roles.later: Making a custom copy of a ready-made role and changing it comes in W2b.
roles.compareHint: What each can do, by area, with the differences marked.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Everything, in every company, including every money figure. The group always keeps one.

admin.name: Administrator
admin.description: People, roles and the audit log; sees no money unless also given a role that does.

finance.name: Finance
finance.description: Invoices, payments and number series; sees prices, costs, margins and wages.

sales.name: Sales
sales.description: Customers, quotes and orders; sees selling prices, not costs or margins.

planner.name: Planner
planner.description: Plans work orders and capacity; sees no money.

buyer.name: Buyer
buyer.description: Suppliers and purchase orders; sees purchase prices (the cost grain).

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Receiving, stock and shipping; sees no money.

production_manager.name: Production manager
production_manager.description: Runs production: work orders, lines and floor results; sees no money.

quality_inspector.name: Quality inspector
quality_inspector.description: Inspects lots and finished goods and releases them; sees no money.

floor_supervisor.name: Floor supervisor
floor_supervisor.description: Follows the lines of their sites from the Office, and keeps their floor devices, workers, badges and PINs; sees no money.

read_only.name: Read-only
read_only.description: Sees every screen its scope reaches and changes nothing; sees no money.

operator.name: Operator
operator.description: Works at a station on an enrolled floor device; sees no money.

cutting_operator.name: Cutting operator
cutting_operator.description: Works at a cutting table on an enrolled floor device; sees no money.

floor_inspector.name: Floor inspector
floor_inspector.description: Inspects work at an inspection bench on an enrolled floor device; sees no money.

team_leader.name: Team leader
team_leader.description: Leads a crew on the floor: works and sees the team leader's screens of the device's site; sees no money.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Keeps the machines running: the machine register, the requests from the stations and the maintenance jobs; signs a machine marked unsafe safe again; sees no money.

technician.name: Maintenance technician
technician.description: Works maintenance jobs on an enrolled floor device and signs a machine marked unsafe safe again with the PIN; sees no money.

held.compareOne: Tick a second role to compare (two or three).
held.compareMany: Compare takes two or three roles: untick the others.

role.readOnlySystem: Ready-made role: read-only. It stays equal to its template.
role.readOnlyCustom: Changing a custom role comes in W2b; it is read-only here for now.
role.mfaRequired: Asks for two-factor before it gives anything
role.everyHint: By area: each action in words, ticked when the role holds it; a mark when it asks for a fresh code.

rules.title: Rules that always apply
rules.hint: Whatever a role holds, these hold too. Read-only.

released.title: Released work orders and issued invoices can't be edited by anyone
released.why: They change only by a new version, a credit note or a reversal.

floorNoCost.title: Floor sessions never see costs, margins or prices
floorNoCost.why: A tablet sees wages at most (A1 §3.11).

partnerPrice.title: Customers and suppliers see prices at most
partnerPrice.why: Portal and link sessions never get costs or margins.

ownRoles.title: Nobody gives themselves a role or edits one they hold
ownRoles.why: Rights are always given by someone else.

lastAdmin.title: The group always keeps one administrator
lastAdmin.why: The last one cannot be suspended, deactivated or lose the role.

stepUp.title: Raising rights asks for a fresh code
stepUp.why: People, roles, badges, PINs and bank details: a code from the authenticator app.

mfa.title: Two-factor
mfa.on: Required: the role gives nothing until two-factor is proved in the session.

role.floorHolders: A floor role is held by floor workers ({count} now); see them in Users › Floor.

devices.intro: The tablets and phones enrolled to the stations, and the printers of the sites. A device says "in use", never who.

tileHint.failedPrinters: The print queue comes in W1

empty.title: No tablets yet
empty.body: Enrol one: it takes a minute with the QR code.

devices.later: The print queue (every label with its tries and Retry) comes in W1; the network a tablet uses is not reported yet.

field.stationHint: Optional: it can move to a station of the same site later.
field.name: Name

devices.modeLater: Its mode (Operator, Cutting, Warehouse…) comes with the floor step: the server has no mode yet.
devices.scanBody: On {name}, open the camera or the Nexus Factory start page and scan this code. It works once, for 15 minutes.
devices.codeExpired: The code expired. Make a new one.
devices.codeRepeat: This code was already shown and is not kept. Make a new one.
devices.readyKiosk: Lock the tablet on the Nexus Factory page (guided access on iPad, screen pinning on Android).
devices.readyCharge: Keep it on its charger at the station.
devices.readyWorkers: Workers sign in with their badge and PIN.

revoke.title: Revoke {name}?
revoke.body: It stops working at once and must be enrolled again to be used.
revoke.bodyInUse: Someone is signed in on it now: their session ends at once, and actions it still has to send will be refused. It must be enrolled again to be used.
revoke.hint: Exactly as written: capital letters and spaces count.
revoke.cardBody: For a lost or retired device: its session ends at once and it must be enrolled again.

held.revoke: None of the selected devices can be revoked: they are revoked already.

bulk.revokeBody_one: Its sign-ins end at once, and it must be enrolled again to be used.
bulk.revokeBody_other: Their sign-ins end at once, and each must be enrolled again to be used.
bulk.inUse_one: {count} of them is in use now: whoever is signed in on it is signed out, and what it still has to send is refused.
bulk.inUse_other: {count} of them are in use now: whoever is signed in on them is signed out, and what they still have to send is refused.

empty.title: No printers
empty.body: Labels print from the browser as PDF until one is added.

form.code: Use up to 24 capital letters, digits or hyphens.
form.codeHint: Unique on the site; it cannot change later.
form.relayHint: Only the test relay serves this environment until the Owner picks a print relay.
form.targetHint: Its network address or queue name, as the relay knows it.
form.statusHint: Paused: jobs wait. Archived: for good.
form.testLater: "Print a test label" comes with the print queue (W1).

held.pause: None of the selected printers is active.
held.resume: None of the selected printers is paused.

bulk.pauseBody_one: A paused printer takes no new labels or documents until it is resumed.
bulk.pauseBody_other: Paused printers take no new labels or documents until they are resumed.
bulk.resumeBody_one: It takes labels and documents again.
bulk.resumeBody_other: They take labels and documents again.

held.revoked: This device is revoked: enrol a new one.

device.revokedBanner: Revoked: it no longer works; it is kept for its history.
device.pendingBanner: Waiting for its tablet to scan the enrolment code.

binding.title: Where it works
binding.hint: Its name and the station whose work it shows.
binding.siteHint: Another site needs a new enrolment.

mode.title: Mode
mode.later: The mode (Operator, Cutting, Warehouse, Packing, Inspection, Supervisor, Display) picks the tiles the tablet shows; it comes with the floor step. The default printers of a device come in W1.

health.title: Is it working?
health.silent: Not seen since {at}: it may be off or out of Wi-Fi.
health.later: The network the tablet uses is not reported yet.
health.outdated: A newer version of the floor app is out ({version}). The tablet updates by itself once nothing waits in its queue.

perm.companies_view: See the companies and whether they can invoice
perm.companies_manage: Add companies and change their legal, e-invoicing and default data
perm.sites_view: See the sites with their lines, work centres and stations
perm.sites_manage: Add and change sites, lines, work centres and stations
perm.users_view: See the people, their status and invitations
perm.users_resetPassword: Force a new password at the next sign-in
perm.roles_view: See the roles and who holds them
perm.audit_read: Read the history of a record
perm.numbering_manage: Create number series and set where they start
perm.files_read: See and download a record's files
perm.files_delete: Delete a file (never one on legal hold)
perm.files_manage: Share files outside the office, set retention and legal hold
perm.links_view: See a record's one-off links and their answers
perm.devices_manage: Enrol, rename and move floor devices; set floor times
perm.devices_revoke: Revoke a lost or retired device
perm.workers_roles: Give and end a worker's floor roles
perm.workers_credentials: Issue badges and reset a worker's PIN
perm.floor_work: Work on an enrolled tablet at the device's site
perm.floor_lead: Lead a crew: the team leader's screens
perm.threads_read: See a record's thread and timeline
perm.threads_post: Write internal notes and mention colleagues
perm.imports_view: See import jobs and their plans
perm.imports_run: Upload a sheet and see its dry run
perm.print_view: See a site's printers and print jobs
perm.email_send: Send mail from a record's thread
perm.email_manage: Manage the sending domains and identities
perm.integrations_view: See the outside services and their calls
perm.compliance_declarations_manage: Upload declarations of conformity and leaflets
perm.compliance_labels_manage: Build and activate garment label templates
perm.product_bom_manage: Edit a draft bill of materials
perm.product_bom_release: Release a revision (freezes BOM, routing and label)
